source: Deadlock Mod Manager performance catalog 2026.11.15-1 (configs are GPL-3.0, credited to their authors)

presets.name: DMM Clean
presets.author: Deadlock Mod Manager
presets.blurb: The settings most community configs agree on, without anything that hides objects, changes the camera or what you can see, or overrides the in-game video menu.

presets.name: OptimizationLock
presets.author: Sqooky
presets.blurb: Sqooky's main config. Upstream describes it as performance-oriented without making the game ugly and recommends it for most players.

presets.name: Eskay's Config
presets.author: Eskay
presets.blurb: A fork of Sqooky's config with moderate changes to suit Eskay's preferences.

presets.name: Sqooky's Max FPS
presets.author: Sqooky
presets.blurb: Sqooky's frame-rate-first config. Upstream marks it as under development and not fully documented.

presets.name: Kaizuchaneru's Minimum Spec
presets.author: Kaizuchaneru
presets.blurb: Prioritizes frame rate above all else and lowers visual quality a lot. Upstream recommends it for weak computers.

presets.name: OptiLock FPS (Recommended)
presets.author: dacooderr
presets.blurb: dacooderr's recommended competitive config. Upstream ships it with a matching set of in-game video settings.

presets.name: OptiLock Potato
presets.author: dacooderr
presets.blurb: dacooderr's lowest-quality config for weak hardware. Upstream ships it with a matching set of in-game video settings.

presets.name: OptiLock Ultra Potato
presets.author: dacooderr
presets.blurb: OptiLock Potato with a shorter draw distance, lower model and decal detail, and more aggressive culling of small objects. For the weakest hardware.
